name: [Portal] Login screen (UI)
description:
**Why?**
The mechanical login helper already exists and is described in `004-auth-wiring.md`; what's missing is the Partner Portal's own login screen. This issue is the front-end screen only — not new authentication logic.

**What?**
Build `/partner-portal/login` per Figma ([node 22:71](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=22-71)), frames "Login page - default" and "Login page - error messages". The design explicitly calls for reusing existing Shoptet login components/variants/colors verbatim — no new design-system work.

**Acceptance Criteria**

- [ ] Page renders per Figma default (164:711) and error-message (168:697) frames, using existing Shoptet login components
- [ ] Successful login redirects to the Partner Portal home
- [ ] Failed login shows the standard error alert
- [ ] Wired to the existing `AdminUserHelper::getCrmAdminUserByCredentials` (`cms/packages/Profiles/Helper/AdminUserHelper.php:300`) — no new auth logic
- [ ] Login is rate-limited per existing CMS4 pattern
- [ ] `make fe-test` covers rendering + both states

**Resources**

- Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=22-71&m=dev
- Backend wiring: `Partner_Portal/issues/03-user-management/004-auth-wiring.md`
